sensitivity_context.purpose: Second correction of the Phase 2 available-N figure, requested during PR #54 review. That PR's N=43 counted all 41 InnoGet Spain-verified records as content-complete (§4.1: substantive technical problem description, minimum 25 words) without actually running them through the real InnogetHtmlNormalizer. Doing so found 1 record with no description at all (EXCLUDED_MISSING_TEXT) and, applying the protocol's literal 25-word threshold (which InnogetHtmlNormalizer itself does not enforce -- it only checks non-emptiness, a separate documented gap), 3 more records with genuine but short (15-24 word) descriptions that fall under it. Corrected: 37 InnoGet + 0 EEN + 2 Lombardia = 39. See docs/phase2-demand-acquisition-audit.md and docs/phase2-sample-size-amendment.md.
